category_title: Students who engage in disruptive vocalizations to gain teacher attention during independent work
scenario_title: Disruptive vocalizations during independent math work
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be completing independent math work while the teacher is busy helping another student.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent math work. Please work on your assignment while I help another student.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks up from his independent math work) Teacher, come look at my paper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am busy working with another student right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not raise his hand) But I want you to come over to me now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a series of high-pitched noises in short bursts, like a shriek and a hoot)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for independent math work. Please work on your assignment while I help another student.

STUDENT: (Looks up from his independent math work) Teacher, come look at my paper.

TUTOR: I am busy working with another student right now.

STUDENT: (Does not raise his hand) But I want you to come over to me now.

TUTOR: Keep working on your own.

STUDENT: (Makes a series of high-pitched noises in short bursts, like a shriek and a hoot)

context.social_setting: teacher is working with someone else

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when I'm busy working with another student
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: a series of high-pitched noises that occur in short bursts, like a shriek or a hoot or a yell
related_quotes: when I'm busy working with another student I hear it a lot.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Tom doesn't do that [raise hand] very often and instead just makes the noises
behavior_patterns.internal_state: it's too easy for him to just make the noises, and I can't get him to remember
related_quotes: it's too easy for him to just make the noises, and I can't get him to remember.
